original_value: Demand forecasting is one of the main issues of supply chains. It aimed to optimize stocks, reduce costs, and increase sales, profit, and customer loyalty. For this purpose, historical data can be analyzed to improve demand forecasting by using various methods like machine learning techniques, time series analysis, and deep learning models. In this work, an intelligent demand forecasting system is developed. This improved model is based on the analysis and interpretation of the historical data by using different forecasting methods which include time series analysis techniques, support vector regression algorithm, and deep learning models. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study to blend the deep learning methodology, support vector regression algorithm, and different time series analysis models by a novel decision integration strategy for demand forecasting approach. The other novelty of this work is the adaptation of boosting ensemble strategy to demand forecasting system by implementing a novel decision integration model. The developed system is applied and tested on real life data obtained from SOK Market in Turkey which operates as a fast‐growing company with 6700 stores, 1500 products, and 23 distribution centers. A wide range of comparative and extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed demand forecasting system exhibits noteworthy results compared to the state‐of‐art studies. Unlike the state‐of‐art studies, inclusion of support vector regression, deep learning model, and a novel integration strategy to the proposed forecasting system ensures significant accuracy improvement.

result.paraphrase: Demand forecasting is a key challenge in supply chains. Its goal is to optimize inventory, lower costs, and boost sales, profit, and customer loyalty. Historical data can be examined to enhance demand prediction using methods such as machine learning, time series analysis, and deep learning models. In this study, an intelligent demand forecasting system is developed. The enhanced model analyzes and interprets historical data using forecasting approaches including time series analysis techniques, support vector regression, and deep learning models. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study to combine deep learning, support vector regression, and multiple time series analysis models through a novel decision integration strategy for demand forecasting. Another novelty is the use of a boosting ensemble strategy in the demand forecasting system by implementing a novel decision integration model. The developed system is applied and tested on real-world data from SOK Market in Turkey, a fast-growing company with 6700 stores, 1500 products, and 23 distribution centers. Extensive comparative experiments show that the proposed demand forecasting system delivers notable results relative to state-of-the-art studies. Compared with prior work, incorporating support vector regression, a deep learning model, and a novel integration strategy into the proposed forecasting system provides a significant improvement in accuracy.
